payload.core_composition_summary: Binary search over answer utilizes sorted shop joy lists; greedy check scans sorted lists to verify that some shop covers two friends and all friends are covered.
payload.rationale: Preprocessing sorts each shop's list of (joy, friend) pairs by joy. Binary search on answer calls greedy feasibility check that iterates sorted arrays to detect a shop with two qualifying friends while aggregating coverage.
